territorial Documented

Rule 3: the upstream catalogue identifies this historical Columbia D 9758/F 87 issue as circa 1925, establishing publication before 1963. Its European 50-year recording term expired before the 2013 extension. Exact first-publication year at the US cutoff is not independently established, and US public-domain status is not asserted. Opened IA metadata has no licenseurl and no non-commercial licence. The Commons composition-only tags are not the acceptance basis.
